reviews.text: We love Dr. Ho and all the vets and people at Kindred! Everyone is so nice and they are so thorough and patient with our pets! They are super transparent about their prices and offer the most affordable options I’ve seen in the city! Their facilities are gorgeous and are always nice and clean.
Fantastic vet! Helped my friend's dog with a severe colon problem. Fair and quick.

My bestie’s pets have received nothing but the very best treatment from Kindred, Particularly Dr. Ho. He has high need pets which have been met with nothing but kindness. Even during stressful moments they’ve truly helped my friend through them, which I greatly appreciate.

Kindred Veterinary deserves every one of these five stars. My dog is a high needs standard poodle. I just have to thank Dr. Ho, Franky, and their entire team for doing everything they could to help my dog Rooibos during an incredibly challenging and difficult time. I always felt they truly cared about him and were doing everything they could to help. They know his personality. I know that because Franky told me once that, “I’m lucky to have such a sweet and gentle boy.” They listened, kept me informed, and treated Rooibos with so much kindness and to the best of their ability. Dr. Ho and her team removed over 2lbs of fecal matter using an enema for him because he couldn’t dedicate. I have to say, I believe that alone is a major achievement and shows their love for helping and caring for animals. I’m incredibly grateful and lucky to have them caring for my boy. They are and will continue to be my primary. Little things like intentionally blocking off time preemptively to get him in if needed are big things in my eyes. Thank you Kindred, from the bottom of my heart.
They are all very kind and take good care of my dog.
Thank you, Leena!
Friendly staff ! Very quick and helpful !

The cleanest vet I’ve ever been at. They explain everything nicely and simple. They are on point if anything is needed for insurance purposes.
The staff is nice and gentle to the pets.

A little expensive and by appointment only. Worth it if you do not go often to the Vet.

Today was our first time visiting Kindred vet. Our cat Sundance wasn’t feeling well so we went in for an illness visit. Dr. Garcia and Josh was a great team to work with. They answered all our questions, was patient with us while created a calming and caring atmosphere for our girl Sundance. We adopted our cat a few months ago and I’m happy that we found an amazing team to take care of her. The pricing was also fair which was another plus! Highly recommended Kindred Veterinary!
Thank you Luis! 😊 …

I was a bit nervous taking Pili(black cat 🐈‍⬛) to the vet on my own for the first time. She needed her nails trimmed and she is not a fan of that, they were patient and took care of her at this visit, I was very happy with everything.

To start this is the longest review I wrote so stay with me. To being with this place has to be a scam, they struggle to listen to the owner (me) and chargers the hell out of you. I SPECIFICALLY told them that my dog was very scared and she bites but the staff couldn't care less thinking she is calm like can't you not read her body language then she has the audacity to tell me that she doesn't look like she needed a muzzle. Well after that they were struggling to put a muzzle on a medium size dog so they called me and ask me to put it on then they took my dog  to the back of the place and one of the workers got bitten by my dog when I told them to be careful and they had 3 people in the room. The craziest excuse was that she took out her muzzle with her paw and turn around quickly then bite her like are we being for real? Later they want to charge me for some pills worth $200 that makes my dog calm like WHAT!! Then they told me if that doesn't work they would sedate her which would be extra charge like you're telling me to buy pills but I can just go straight to sedation I did pay for it cause I was already mad at that point. Since my dog ended up biting one of the workers by law I have to pay for some bs of a rabie test that is not even a test more like check up after 10 days which I'll be missing work because of it.

Staff were over confident and ignore my advice about my dog thinking they know my dog better than me,. Over priced like crazy, take the time to travel further to save yourself 500 dollars. Now I gotta pay 150 more for their mistake and have to return wasting my time. Huge inconvenience and not worth it.
Very good with our dog. Not cheap
Everyone is very nice and caring.

The office manager Milo is such a hard worker along with all of the other staff! The front desk is very friendly and happy to help. I was there 03/09/2026 and the 3 women at the front desk made my day with their kindness and friendly attitudes! This place is amazing and they genuinely care.
Thank you, C.A.M.!

We’ve been getting care for our dogs here for the last 5 years and have nothing but great experiences. From the point of check in, you are greeted by warm people and vet techs that are passionate and gentle with your pets. Dr Ho is amazing, and has been invaluable for various medical visits/emergency situations that have occurred over the years. We moved 20 min away and did not even once consider changing vets. Cannot recommend them enough!

Dr. Patty Ho and her Team are amazing! My dog, unexpectedly, swallowed a large foreign object today and within minutes of notifying the clinic, they squeezed us in! Luckily, they were able to induce vomiting and attend to my pet's needs! Kindred is reliable, attentive, and genuinely care for the welfare of their patients! Top notch service and we are so grateful for your expertise during stressful situations. Thank you Team Kindred!
The staff is so wonderful and kind, they really want what’s best for your loved one and work with what you can afford instead of against

The Kindred team is amazing and has taken great care of my cats for years - from routine check ups to concerning illnesses or dental cleanings. Transparent pricing, consistent communication, and true passion for animals.

I brought my cat here after and everyone was so friendly and helpful. They listen and explain and make sure you’re going home without any questions or concerns for your pet. 10/10, can’t see me taking my cat anywhere else.

I needed urgent care for my cat and spoke with 3 administrative employees, a vet tech, and a veterinarian during the visit and beforehand (while trying to figure out my schedule). Every staff member was kind and patient with me, and the vet proactively asked about my budget and discussed different levels of care and outcomes I could expect. My cat is elderly and has several issues, but the staff did not pressure me to try and solve them all at once, instead they learned about my priorities and budget and made recommendations for what to treat now vs later. Pricing is also a bit lower than where I used to go. I highly recommend this clinic!
Thank you, Chris!

We really enjoy bringing our two kitties to Kindred. Prior to Kindred we’ve been to three different clinics with 7+ veterinarians and we’ve never felt great with the care our cats received, but at Kindred we can tell the veterinarians really care about our cats. They often discuss preventative care such as brushing teeth, which at other clinics we noticed they did not, even when we would bring it up. They are very thorough in examining our cats, addressing our concerns, and we don’t feel rushed during our appointments. From regular check-ups to a big dental surgery, we’ve always felt like our kitties were in good hands. We’re very thankful our kitties are cared for at Kindred!
My cat loved them she let them take care of her.

i can't say enough how wonderful our experience has been with kindred! they are kind, patient, thorough, and communicative. we've had to see them in both times of distress and not and all around they're wonderful. my dog has anxiety about getting her nails trimmed and other places used to say they couldn't do it without sedating her but now we have no issues. it is such a relief to have good care for our pup, she does amazing with them! bonus that we don't have to wait weeks to be seen! again, kindred is the best.
All the staff and Dr. Ho are very friendly at Kindred. Everyone always answers my questions. I like bringing my cats here when they get sick.
Thank you, Michael!

Loved them ! Genuinely concerned for my baby’s well being. My girl got a swollen face from a little tangle with a bee. They were able to squeeze in my unexpected visit to the office. They were so nice and my dog liked them so much that she would cry a little when vet and staff left the room. My dog got some shots and she was good as new, swelling was significantly down when we left
I appreciate Dr. Ho and the vet techs. My girls get such great care here and they meet us where we are at. They are always so friendly and accommodating to my pets’ needs.

I love Kindred Vet… I drive from Edgewater down to Pilsen because the veterinarians and the staff are incredible… There’s almost never a wait. They are knowledgeable. They’re kind. they’re flexible. they go the extra mile… Once when my dog was sick, the vet called an hour after hours were over just to make sure that I had what I needed
So incredibly grateful for Kindred. Dr. Ho and her team always make us feel at home. Unbeatable service and quality of care, cannot recommend highly enough.
Dr. Ho treated my cat with such care, and she communicated everything very clearly! The same goes for the rest of the team. Would recommend.

Great animal hospital in Pilsen. The staff is extremely friendly and welcoming in addition to being very communicative and efficient. Dr. Ho was very thorough and patient. She listened to all my concerns and worked within my budget constraints to create the best course of action for my dog. I highly recommend Kindred Veterinary!
Great veterinary, we’ve being coming here for a few years now and the staff is kind and professional. So happy to have found them
Thank you, David!
Thank you Sara!
Very kind and informative people. We took in a stray cat recently, and they gave us everything we needed to know. We will definitely be going back!

The first time I went my cat had a stomach ache and it was about $1k for that visit just to get some stomach medicine. Just took my kitten to get some vaccines they added extra stuff to visit not sure what all was 100% necessary and it cost $375 for not even all of the vaccines to get the second half was looking to be another $200-$300. Compared to other vet offices these are extremely premium prices. The service is okay, I paid for some sort of medication that was given to my kitten in the mouth at least half did not go into his mouth but still had to pay 100% of the cost. The benefit of going here is you can get a vet appointment quite quickly and the staff is knowledgeable. However know you are paying premium price, if you do not have pet insurance it’s going to be hefty bill.

They are so sweet and so kind here. I had been bringing my dog for years. He was older and they always kept our best interests top of mind.   You can just really tell they care. My dog was picky and didn't like their treats. They actually got different ones for him for his visits. He recently passed away and I not only got the nicest voicemail from his vet Dr. Ho, but she also sent a condolences card, where all the vet techs signed and wrote a sweet message. So thoughtful. One of the best vets I've been to. Many thanks 🙏🏼
Amazing service and care for my little pups!

I unfortunately had to put my baby down there as after all the blood work, tests, and treatment there was nothing that could be done for her. I didnt have the money the day of and the clinic was nice enough to perform the services and …
Thank you, Llysa!
After having a not so great experience the first time I came, I made another appointment and I gave it a second chance because it’s in the neighborhood and super convenient. I’m glad that I did. …
The team here is super knowledgeable and helpful. We’ve had amazing experiences for our big dog. Highly recommend!
Amazing techs! Amazing doctors! Everyone is so kind and knowledgeable, and makes you feel welcome and cared for. My boys Louis and Bender are patients there and I wouldn’t take them anywhere else
